label: Shortcuts via help-modal link
verdict:
**Not clean — a few issues:**

**FIX — Misplaced "Daytime" chip/tooltip:** It floats at the top-center of the canvas (~778,73), detached from anything, while the Sun control it presumably belongs to is at the *bottom*-center (~677,743). Looks like a tooltip anchored to the wrong parent. Re-anchor it to the Sun button, or restyle it as a proper status chip.

**FIX — Ambiguous "5 ft" label on the sun slider:** The bottom slider row reads [slider] [Sun] [slider] **5 ft**. Feet make no sense as a sun/time-of-day value, and the dual-track-plus-button layout is ambiguous (one slider or two? unlabeled). Relabel (e.g., time value like "2 PM") and label the tracks, or move the ft label to the brush control it belongs to.

**FIX — FPS: 2 in the status bar:** Severe render stall. Combined with the nearly empty, flat-dark viewport, the scene reads as broken/stuck rather than "yard is empty." Fix perf or show a loading/empty-state hint.

**MINOR — Clipped keycap:** In the modal, the arrow-keys cap shows "↑ ↓ ←" with the "→" apparently cut off at the key edge. Widen the cap.

**5-second comprehension:** Good — "Keyboard Shortcuts" title, Advanced badge, clear two-column layout, and the full-width "Got It!" button make the modal itself instantly understandable, and the left sidebar explains the app. The issues above are the only friction points; no element overlaps or clips the modal illegally (sidebar/toolbar occlusion behind it is expected modal behavior).
